title: How I Work | Scope It, Shape It, Ship It | Huston Logic
description: One process for websites and systems: a free 20-minute call, then Scope it, Shape it, Ship it. You see the plan and price before I build, and I hand everything over whenever you ask.

content.title: You see the price before I build anything.
content.intro: Every project, website or system, runs the same three steps. A free 20-minute call comes first. It isn't a step, because it costs nothing and commits you to nothing.

content.heading: Step zero: a free 20-minute call
content.body: A real conversation, not a sales demo. Tell me what you need: a new site, a system for your business, or both. I'll ask what you use today and who'd own the result, then give you my honest take, including when a settings change, your software vendor's support team or a different specialist is the better bet.

website.paragraph: After the call, you send me a short brief: what the site has to do, your words, photos and logo, and two or three sites you like. I send back a written plan and a fixed price. This step has no separate fee.
website.youGet: a page list, what each page does, what I need from you, the price and a launch window.

system.paragraph: A design call: your stages and follow-up rules. Then a written plan and a fixed price.

website.paragraph: I design and build the site and show it to you on a private preview link. You get one round of changes. Then I try to break it: phones and desktops, slow connections, keyboard-only use, and test inquiries through the form, plus automated accessibility, speed and security checks.
website.youGet: a preview link, one revision round, and a site that has passed its checks.

system.paragraph: Your own copy set up and hosted in my accounts, your form connected, your contacts imported. I test it end to end before you use it.

website.paragraph: The site goes live on your domain. The domain and your email stay in your name, and I host the site and its form in my own accounts for a flat fee. You get a short guide to what's where. For six weeks after launch, small changes are included, and I fix anything that doesn't work as agreed.
website.youGet: the live site · a handoff guide · everything handed over whenever you ask · six weeks of small changes and fixes.

system.paragraph: 30 days of tuning, a one-page handoff, and a full export whenever you want one.

proof.text: All three client wrap-up surveys so far rated handoff and training 5/5.

paragraphs.text: Some clients want someone keeping an eye on things.

link.label: Site Care for a website, the care plan for a system. Neither is required.

paragraphs.text: I don't make 40-slide strategy decks. You get one useful improvement at a time.

content.heading: Start with the free call.
content.body: Twenty minutes is enough to know which column you're in.
